t: You're standing at numbers 40 and 42 Kingsway, in Camden. This building was designed by Edwin Lutyens, one of the most celebrated British architects of the twentieth century. He's known for adapting traditional styles to the needs of his time, and he designed country houses, war memorials and public buildings. His biographer Christopher Hussey wrote that he was widely held to be our greatest architect since Wren. Gavin Stamp called him surely the greatest British architect of the twentieth century.
